name: Korean Airlines Co.,Ltd.
summary: Korean Airlines Co.,Ltd. provides airline services. It operates through Air Transport, Aerospace, Hotel, and Others segments. The company provides passenger and cargo transportation services and maintenance of aircraft and manufacturing of aircraft parts. It also engages in hotel, hotel management, accommodation, software development and supply, aircraft engine repair, sports and leisure services, cargo information network service, online sales, aircraft transport services, information technology services, airport support services, online sales, facilities support management services, and small aircraft transport service.
